_comment: Tool registry for the Hermes gateway, which runs on the AGENTS VM.
The stable contract is the shell commands, not this file's schema: if your
Hermes build expects a different manifest shape, keep the commands and
re-shape the wrapper. Every command is safe to run from the repo root as
the 'hermes' user and prints a machine-readable report block at the end.
Two things to know about the topology:
- the APPLICATION runs on a different VM. Anything touching it goes
through scripts/agent/app-exec.sh, which is an allowlist of six verbs
over Tailscale SSH, not a shell.
- the code agent NEVER pushes to main. It opens a pull request with
auto-merge on, and the required checks decide whether it lands.

tools.name: project_status
tools.description: Read-only snapshot: current commit, dirty files, spec status board, production health, running containers, recent agent runs. Use for any question about the state of the project or of production.

tools.name: run_pipeline
tools.description: The full spec-driven loop for a change request: write or amend the spec, implement it, review it, then open a PULL REQUEST with auto-merge enabled. The required checks merge it and the Deploy workflow ships it — this tool does not deploy anything itself. Stops by itself if the spec has open questions a human must answer. The default tool for 'change the app so ...'.

args.name: request
args.description: The human's request, verbatim, in the language they used.

tools.name: write_spec
tools.description: Write or amend a specification only, without implementing it. Use when the human wants to agree on the behaviour before any code is written.

tools.name: implement_spec
tools.description: Implement a specification that already exists and is ready for code. Takes a spec id such as 0004, or a path such as specs/0004-match-lifecycle.md.

tools.name: review_changes
tools.description: Read-only review of the most recent commit against its specification and the project conventions. Returns findings; changes nothing.

args.name: spec
args.description: Optional spec id or path; inferred from the commit trailer if omitted.

tools.name: deploy
tools.description: Redeploy an image that already exists in GHCR, on the application VM, with no downtime. Ordinary releases come from GitHub Actions on main — use this only to redeploy a known tag.

args.name: tag
args.description: Image tag, e.g. sha-a1b2c3d, from deploy_status or the Actions run.

tools.name: deploy_status
tools.description: Which colour is live on the application VM, which image and commit it runs, the previous deploy, and the current health response. Read-only.

tools.name: rollback
tools.description: Return the application to the previous image, with no downtime. CODE ONLY: the database is never rolled back, because reverting it would destroy results players entered since the deploy. Use when the site is broken and the cause is the last release.

tools.name: check_errors
tools.description: Run the error watcher once, now: health, recent log errors, disk. Sends an alert if it finds something new. Use when somebody says the site is misbehaving.

tools.name: test_alerts
tools.description: Send a test message to the alert channels, to prove they work before the party rather than during it.

tools.name: pr_status
tools.description: Where the code agent's pull requests stand: open ones, whether auto-merge is on, and the state of their checks. Use to answer 'is it live yet?' — a change is live only once its PR merged AND the Deploy workflow finished.

args.name: number
args.description: A PR number for detail; omit for all open ones.

tools.name: app_logs
tools.description: Recent logs from the application VM. Optionally one service: app-blue, app-green, caddy, cloudflared, sweeper. Read-only.
